resources.string: Show HomePod Bridge receivers in the media output picker for Apple Music.
Connect to the same Wi-Fi as your HomePod, allow audio sharing, then choose a speaker. After enabling the module in Vector, receivers can also appear in the system media output picker.

Audio sharing ended. Tap Allow audio sharing to start again.

Experimental • Android 16/17\nWith Vector enabled, system audio routing shares the selected app’s media audio. The microphone is never opened. Without the module, Android’s audio-sharing consent is required for Apple Music. HomePod stereo pairs and the Apple Music in-app Cast picker have not been verified.
